items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 38:1
items.html:
(To the question) Expansion of the five Gevurot
The root of the five Hassadim is in Yesod, below all the five Hassadim. However, when they come into a coupling, their level is equal, for there is in them an expansion of the five Gevurot from the aspect of below upward to the aspect of above downward, in all five aspects: HGT, NH. (p. 521, Item 44)
